$comment: Typed questions for Laya and Jev (same schema). Ask what the text says; map answers to CRM actions in code. See .claude/skills/laya-integration.

stage.instructions: What does this email tell the candidate about their job application?

criteria.received: confirms an application was received or is under review
criteria.interview: invites to, schedules or moves an interview or assessment
criteria.offer: makes or discusses a job offer, salary or contract
criteria.rejection: declines the application or says the role is filled
criteria.recruiter_outreach: a recruiter introduces a new role the candidate has not applied for
criteria.other: newsletters, job alerts, receipts and anything else

needs_reply.instructions: Does the sender ask the candidate to reply, confirm or choose a time?

urgency.instructions: How soon does the candidate need to act on this email?
criteria: within a day or a stated deadline
